couchcoop_qr_no_address: No host address available — check the browser server started.
couchcoop_qr_network_connection_descript: Choose which network connection and link type phones use to join. Change this if a phone cannot connect, or if you want to try a faster, more reliable option.
couchcoop_steam_offline: Steam offline — remote friends can't join. Couch/LAN play only.
couchcoop_option_server_not_listening: The browser server is not listening yet.
couchcoop_option_address_not_eligible: Needs a normal network address on this PC.
couchcoop_option_secure_pending: Still setting up — the plain address still works.
couchcoop_secure_address_ineligible: Needs a normal network address on this PC.
couchcoop_secure_port_failed: Could not open the secure port.
couchcoop_secure_setup_failed: Setup failed — the plain address still works.
couchcoop_secure_provider_unavailable: No internet, or the certificate service is down.
couchcoop_secure_certificate_key_mismatc: The published certificate and key do not match.
couchcoop_secure_certificate_not_valid_y: The published certificate is not valid yet.
couchcoop_secure_certificate_expired: The published certificate has expired — it usually returns within a day.
couchcoop_secure_certificate_load_failed: This PC could not load the published certificate.
couchcoop_qr_adapter_ethernet_descriptio: This PC is plugged in with a cable — the steadiest option, with the least lag. Your phone still joins over Wi-Fi, but the PC's half of the connection is as good as it gets.
couchcoop_qr_adapter_wifi_description: This PC is on Wi-Fi. It works, but it's less stable than a cable — expect a little more lag or stutter, especially far from the router. If the PC also has a wired option, prefer that.
couchcoop_qr_adapter_other_description: A VPN or virtual network (Tailscale, a work VPN, and the like). Only phones on that same network can use this address — on normal home Wi-Fi, pick one of the options above instead.
couchcoop_qr_method_ipv4_description: The simplest link, and the only one that needs no internet at all. The phone runs a bit slower on it — a secure (https) link lets the browser use extra speed features, which means better fps and battery. Can't be installed as an app (except on iPhone).
couchcoop_qr_method_web_description: Loads from the internet, then connects straight to this PC. The phone will ask permission for the site to reach your local network — that only lets it reach programs that explicitly accept connections from this site, like this game. Best fps and battery. Needs internet on the phone, and doesn't work on iPhone yet.
couchcoop_qr_method_secure_description: A secure (https) link straight to this PC — better fps and battery than the plain address, and the phone can install it like a real app. Some routers or internet providers block this kind of address; if it won't load, pick another option. Needs internet.
couchcoop_qr_method_mdns_description: Uses this PC's name instead of numbers — easy to remember and type by hand. But many phones and routers can't find these names, so it's the least reliable option. If it won't load, use one of the addresses above.
couchcoop_qr_method_override_description: This address was pinned by the COUCHCOOP_ADVERTISED_HOST setting on this PC, so the dialog shows exactly what was configured.
couchcoop_qr_mdns_untrusted_suffix: Heads up: this name didn't answer when we tested it on your network just now.
couchcoop_connection_copy_failed: Couldn't verify the clipboard. Select Copy report and try again.
couchcoop_connection_error_launch_summar: The player game could not start.
couchcoop_connection_error_join_summary: The player game lost its connection.
couchcoop_connection_error_mod_mismatch_: This player's game loaded a different copy of CouchCoop.
Keep only one copy of the mod installed, restart the game, then try again.
couchcoop_connection_error_browser_summa: The browser could not show the game view.
couchcoop_connection_error_browser_actio: Reload the browser, then join again.
couchcoop_connection_error_service_actio: Return to the lobby and try again.
couchcoop_connection_error_patch_summary: Couch Co-Op could not attach to the game, so co-op cannot run this session.
couchcoop_connection_error_patch_action: Restart the game. If co-op still does not start, copy this report.
couchcoop_connection_error_shared_profil: Players on this computer share one game profile and one log file.
Co-op still works. Avoid changing game settings while other players are connected.
couchcoop_connection_empty: Devices appear here after connecting to the browser server. Use the same Wi-Fi network and check the address shown above.
couchcoop_connection_error_slow_summary: Waiting for the browser to display the game.
couchcoop_connection_error_slow_action: Keep this tab open. Reload it if loading does not finish.
couchcoop_connection_outcome_detail_wait: Still waiting for the game view. This attempt can still finish.
couchcoop_connection_outcome_detail_fail: This attempt stopped. Follow the suggested steps, then reconnect.
couchcoop_connection_outcome_detail_reco: The game view is now working. This earlier warning is saved for reference.
couchcoop_connection_outcome_detail_ende: This connection ended before the delay cleared.
couchcoop_connection_outcome_detail_degr: Co-op is running with a limitation. It is saved here for reference.
